defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its meet-in-the-middle implementation materializes/enumerates an enormous number of half-subsets and runs out of runtime or memory on worst-case inputs.
It relies on enumerating combinations of vertices, which becomes infeasible for n up to 46 and causes a runtime error.
Its later construction is not a complete, correctly justified exact search; the shown special-case logic and heuristic handling fail to guarantee a valid size-k independent set for all graphs.

recommended_edit: Replace "Any valid assignment meeting the criteria is accepted" with a requirement to output the lexicographically smallest valid k-element set.
